coverage: 1969–2026 selected major CERN experiment milestones and the complete named Standard Model particle types plus composite scale references
disclaimers: A particle's mass or Compton wavelength is NOT its physical radius.

Elementary Standard Model particles have no measured geometric size. The quark/electron <10^-19 m figure is a representative resolution statement from CERN educational material, not separately proven radius limits for each species.
Physical proton/pion/kaon charge radii are rms radii, not hard sphere boundaries.
Timeline is selected highlights, not every CERN experiment since 1969.
Discoveries of charm, bottom, top, gluon and tau neutrino were made outside CERN; do not reattribute them.
